units.source_text: 冷泉帝常穿墨色丧服，其清秀之容姿，与源氏内大臣毫无差异。

en.t: Emperor Reizei often wore dark mourning robes, and his delicate, handsome appearance was no different from that of Genji, the Minister of the Interior.

units.source_text: 他以前揽镜自照，亦常有此感想。

en.t: In the past, whenever he looked at himself in a mirror, he had often felt the same way.

units.source_text: 自从听了僧都的话以后，再行细看源氏内大臣的相貌，越发深切地感到父子之爱了。

en.t: After hearing what the bishop had said, he looked more closely at Genji's features and felt the bond between father and son all the more deeply.

units.source_text: 他总想找个机会，向他隐约提到此事。

en.t: He was always hoping to find an opportunity to hint at the matter to him.

units.source_text: 然而又恐源氏内大臣难以为情，幼小的心中便鼓不起勇气。

en.t: Yet he feared that Genji would be embarrassed, and in his young heart he could not summon the courage.

units.source_text: 因此这期间他们只谈些寻常闲话，不过比以前更加亲昵了。

en.t: So during this time they spoke only of ordinary things, though they became more intimate than before.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝对他态度异常恭敬，与从前迥不相同，

en.t: Emperor Reizei's manner toward him was unusually respectful, utterly unlike before,

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣眼明心慧，早已看出，暗中觉得惊异，然而料不到他已经详悉底蕴了。

en.t: and Genji, sharp-eyed and perceptive, had long since noticed it and was secretly astonished, though he never imagined that the emperor already knew the whole truth.
